conventions.reference_dilaton: varphi=0 at the reference radial coordinate in this source chart
conventions.action_density: sqrt(-gtilde) exp(k varphi) [Rtilde - h1/2 (dvarphi)^2 - sum_m h2m dvarphi.dX_m - 1/2 h3mn dX_m.dX_n + V]
conventions.potential_sign: V is positive at the SO(7) origin
conventions.multiplicative_dilatons: X1,...,X6 are positive scalar coordinates, not their logarithms

expression_format.exactness: All coefficients are exact integers/rationals. No numerical fitting, Float coefficients, or unevaluated external definitions.
expression_format.symbols: The shape coordinates are fields after the first entry; g is the electric gauge coupling. The functions do not depend on varphi.
expression_format.import: Read each expression string with ToExpression[text, InputForm] in the same symbol context as fields; h2m is ordered by fields after the first entry.
